name: Special Module in Policy Studies
description: The objective of this course is to introduce students to current salient and emergent topics at the intersection of science, technology, and development. The course aims to enable students to critically engage with these topics from a science and technology policy perspective. For the particular domain, topic or issue chosen by the instructor (for example climate change, energy, agriculture etc.) the course would familiarize students with key concepts in science and technology policy making. It would include studying various instruments, actors and stages in the policy process and policy cycle, and critical perspectives on unpacking and understanding methods of policy analysis for the particular issue chosen by the instructor.
